description: Explicit door requirement lookup keyed by 'from->to'. Separated from rooms.json so agents and tools can query requirements without traversing the full room graph.

R2->R6.notes: glyph_key must be in inventory AND glyph_key_id must equal the computed id.

R6->R2.notes: glyph_key must be in inventory AND glyph_key_id must equal the computed id.

R5->R7.notes: lit_torch AND glyph_key (with correct id) required. Also blocked if player holds cursed_idol unless epoch_phase is eclipse. Use the 'exit' action (not 'move').
